Veterans Benefits: Disabled-veteran property-tax exemption, veterans hiring preference, state education/tuition assistance, free state park admission through disabled-veteran Honor Pass, plates, hunting/fishing privileges.
Description: Clearfield is a defense and aerospace hub in Davis County, Utah, situated adjacent to Hill Air Force Base and Falcon Hill Aerospace Research Park. It offers military retirees strong employment opportunities in defense industries, low overall crime, and quick access to Wasatch Front outdoor recreation.
